step.label: Receive and Log Service Request
step.description: Capture incoming service tickets and change requests from customers or internal teams into a centralized management system.
step.useCase: An IT technician receives a customer report of equipment failure and logs it as a service ticket for tracking.

step.label: Analyze Change Impact and Materials
step.description: Evaluate engineering changes required to resolve the service issue and identify materials needed for remediation.
step.useCase: The system determines that the equipment failure requires a component replacement and identifies available materials from inventory.

step.label: Convert Service to Sales Opportunity
step.description: Transform the service request into a revenue-generating sales opportunity if additional products or services are needed.
step.useCase: The service ticket triggers recognition of an upsell opportunity for a system upgrade, which is automatically converted to a sales order.

step.label: Assess Equipment and Production Impact
step.description: Evaluate current machine status and production order schedules to understand operational impact and prioritize resolution urgency.
step.useCase: The system checks production schedules and determines that the equipment failure affects three critical manufacturing orders due today.

step.label: Allocate Workforce and Schedule Resources
step.description: Identify available technicians and schedule them to address the service ticket based on urgency and resource availability.
step.useCase: Payroll and workforce data identifies two available technicians; their availability is checked and the nearest one is assigned to the job.

step.label: Adjust Compensation for Emergency Response
step.description: Apply bonus or overtime compensation rules for technicians assigned to high-priority urgent service requests.
step.useCase: Because the assigned technician is handling a critical production emergency, the system automatically applies a 15% emergency response bonus.

step.label: Validate Compensation Against Policy
step.description: Ensure all compensation adjustments comply with company compensation policies and regulatory requirements before finalization.
step.useCase: The compensation policy engine confirms that emergency bonuses do not exceed the quarterly cap and approves the adjustment.

step.label: Generate Analytics and Impact Report
step.description: Produce comprehensive analytics on service resolution, equipment maintenance patterns, and change impact for continuous improvement and decision-making.
step.useCase: Post-resolution, the system generates a report showing that this equipment failure was linked to a previous change, enabling root-cause analysis and preventive measures.

conditionalGate.condition: Root cause indicates systemic change required
